label: Hex Gauge
author: Conky-Studio
description: Hexagonal ring gauge: track + progressive fill along the six sides. Distinct from circular arc gauges.
lua_draw_body:
local cx, cy, R = {cx}, {cy}, {radius}
 local min_v, max_v = {min_value}, {max_value}
 local span = max_v - min_v; if span == 0 then span = 1 end
 local pct = ((tonumber({value}) or min_v) - min_v) / span
 if pct < 0 then pct = 0 elseif pct > 1 then pct = 1 end
 local rot = math.rad({rotation_deg})
 local pts = {}
 for i = 0, 6 do
  local a = rot + i * math.pi / 3
  pts[#pts+1] = {cx + math.cos(a) * R, cy + math.sin(a) * R}
 end
 local function stroke_poly(alpha, col, upto)
  local rr, gg, bb = col[1], col[2], col[3]
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, rr, gg, bb, alpha)
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, {thickness})
  cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND)
  cairo_set_line_join(cr, CAIRO_LINE_JOIN_ROUND)
  local total = 6
  local remain = upto * total
  cairo_new_path(cr)
  for i = 1, 6 do
   local seg = math.min(1, math.max(0, remain))
   if seg <= 0 then break end
   local x1, y1 = pts[i][1], pts[i][2]
   local x2, y2 = pts[i+1][1], pts[i+1][2]
   if i == 1 then cairo_move_to(cr, x1, y1) end
   if seg >= 1 then
    cairo_line_to(cr, x2, y2)
   else
    cairo_line_to(cr, x1 + (x2 - x1) * seg, y1 + (y2 - y1) * seg)
   end
   remain = remain - 1
  end
  cairo_stroke(cr)
 end
 local tr, tg, tb = {track_color}
 local fr, fg, fb = {color}
 stroke_poly({opacity} * 0.7, {tr, tg, tb}, 1)
 stroke_poly({opacity}, {fr, fg, fb}, pct)
